responsibility: This header declares the vec_perm_indices class, GCC’s canonical representation of constant vector permutation masks. It defines the stored encoding, tracks the number of input vectors and elements per input, provides accessors and predicates for clamped permutation elements and input-range membership, and exposes conversion helpers between permutation builders, TREE vector constants, and RTL CONST_VECTORs.
same_name_distinction: Declares the vec_perm_indices representation, its stored state, constructors, and lightweight inline queries such as clamp and all_from_input_p; the same-stem .cc file contains the substantive transformation algorithms and TREE/RTL conversion routines.
